I’ll search the knowledge base for the paper title and the fish-bag volume, using the available documents first.
```python
paper_search = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet? fish bag volume m^3", scope="session")

The title is specific, so I’m checking the public web as a fallback for the paper’s stated calculation.
```python
paper_web_search = await web_search('"Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?" fish bag volume', max_results=5)
print(paper_web_search)
```
